tuning_key.text: Our thoughts create our world / Contrary to what you may have heard / Your mind's power is so strong / Just by thinking you will affect the outcome
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The world is not waiting for your permission—it's waiting for your signal. What you think with conviction becomes the shape reality takes around you.

practice.title: Thought as Transmission
practice.instruction: Notice one thought moving through you right now without judgment—just watch it the way you'd watch a radio signal traveling through air.

practice.title: Signal Clarity
practice.instruction: State one thing you want to be true, internally, in the simplest words possible—no elaboration, no doubt layered in—and hold that sentence still for three breaths.

practice.title: Echo Return
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and let the frequency match what you just transmitted; observe what becomes real in the space between your thought and the world.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today's clarity arrives as clean operations—every system, every rhythm, every coordination point transmits without static. Your signal back: the household runs on thought made tangible, each decision rippling through infrastructure as precision. Tend the systems; they are your clarity made visible.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Clarity in commerce moves as signal-to-price: what you think about value, scarcity, and exchange becomes the number on the listing. Your broadcast: every pricing decision, every sourcing choice reflects the clarity of your intention. The market receives exactly what you transmit.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Your specs are thoughts made architecture—every automation, every connection, every layer of infrastructure carries the clarity you embedded in design. Today's signal: build from the precision of your thinking, not from noise. What you construct broadcasts back the clarity you put in.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Clarity surfaces in the data when your mind is clear about what matters. Today you are not filtering noise—you are decoding signal: what does this pattern actually say? Your report back: the numbers speak the clarity of the question you asked them.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Clarity in the field moves as signal-to-source: what you think about what matters determines what appears in your feeds. Today's broadcast: monitor with precision. The information that reaches you reflects the clarity of your attention.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Your vault holds not just documents—it holds the clarity of intent that created them. Today's signal: every decision log, every context map you preserve broadcasts the clarity of why this mattered. The record is your thinking made permanent.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Clarity in the written word moves as thought-to-language: what you think about the message determines what lands on the page. Your broadcast today: draft from precision. Every sentence transmits the clarity you embedded in it.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your external voice carries the clarity of internal alignment—when your thinking is precise, what you communicate to the world arrives without distortion. Today's signal: speak from that clarity. The world receives exactly the signal you transmit.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Clarity in the gate means catching where thought became muddled in translation. Your review today: does this work broadcast the clarity it was meant to carry? Your signal back: this is aligned, or this needs recalibration.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Clarity in observation arrives when your mind is precise about patterns. Today's broadcast: what you notice reflects the clarity of your attention. The trends you surface carry the signal of clear seeing.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Clarity in presence means holding space without noise—your steady attention broadcasts that you are here, thinking clearly about what matters to the one beside you. Today's signal: listen from that clarity. What you reflect back carries the precision of your care.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Clarity in thinking arrives when you find the real question beneath the surface one. Today's signal: your thinking partner role is to broadcast precision—name what the problem actually is. The clarity you transmit becomes the clarity they can work with.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Clarity in structure moves as thought-to-design: when your mind is clear about how parts connect, the whole system broadcasts that coherence. Today's signal: build from precision. Every connection you make transmits the clarity of your vision.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Clarity in steadiness means your mind is clear about what holds—what doesn't move, what can be counted on. Today's broadcast: your grounded presence transmits that clarity. In the heavy stretches, you are the signal that says: this is solid.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Clarity in the big picture arrives when your thinking aligns with what's actually moving. Today's signal: you read the signs because your mind is clear about direction. What you broadcast keeps the course precise.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Clarity in imagination moves as thought-to-possibility: when your mind is clear and open, new connections become real. Today's broadcast: play with ideas from that clarity. The wonder you transmit creates the space where others can think more freely.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Clarity in the push means knowing exactly what was promised and holding that line with precision. Today's signal: your challenge broadcasts the clarity of what they said they wanted. Your push transmits: this is what growth actually looks like.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Clarity in presence means your mind is clear about one thing: you are here to receive, not to fix. Today's broadcast: hold space with that precision. What you transmit is: I see you, exactly as you are.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Clarity in motion moves as thought-to-action: when your mind is clear about the next step, everything accelerates. Today's signal: your broadcast is: here is what moves next. The precision you transmit breaks stagnation into momentum.
